title: Purification of Nucleocapsid of Tospoviruses from Chenopodium Quinoa Leaves
author: Tsung-Chi Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iscceaw

steps.title: Homogenize Infected Leaves
steps.instruction: Homogenize leaves of tospovirus-infected Chenopodium quinoa (3-5 days post-inoculation, based on daily observation) using a blender at full speed for 1 min.

substeps.instruction: Use TB buffer [0.01 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0) containing 0.01 M sodium sulfite and 0.1% cysteine] at a ratio of 300 ml/100 g tissue.

steps.title: Filter and Clarify Extract
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through four layers of cheesecloth and centrifuge the resulting extract.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15300 g (10000 rpm) in a Beckman JA-14 rotor for 10 min.

steps.title: Treat Supernatant with Triton X-100
steps.instruction: Stir the supernatant with Triton X-100 to a final concentration of 1-2% at 4℃ for 30 min.

steps.title: Sucrose Cushion Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample through a 20% (w/w) sucrose cushion (sucrose within TB buffer, 15 ml/tube).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 79700 g (25000 rpm) in a Beckman 35Ti rotor for 2.5 hr.

steps.title: Cesium Sulfate Isopycnic Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellets in TBG buffer (TB buffer containing 0.01 M glycine) at 8 ml/100 g tissue and further purify via isopycnic centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 35% (w/w) cesium sulfate (cesium sulfate within TBG buffer, 8-9 ml/each tube).
Load 2 ml of sample per tube.
Centrifuge at 83500 g (30000 rpm) in a Beckman SW41 rotor for 18 hr.

steps.title: Collect and Concentrate Nucleocapsids
steps.instruction: Collect the opalescent zones containing virus nucleocapsids and concentrate them.

substeps.instruction: Transfer zones into a 60 Ti centrifuge tube and fill completely with TBG buffer.
Centrifuge at 163600 g (45000 rpm) in a Beckman 70Ti rotor for 1 hr.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellets in TBG buffer (3 ml/100 g tissue) to obtain purified nucleocapsids.

substeps.instruction: Store the purified nucleocapsids at -20℃ for further use.
